sources.title: Chest X-Ray Classifier using Transfer Learning (VGG16)
sources.snippet: This project implements a deep learning model for classifying chest X-ray images into different categories (such as Normal, Pneumonia, etc.) using transfer learning with the VGG16 architecture. The goal is to support rapid and accurate medical diagnosis through automated image classification.
